title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether the Guarantor Shall Assume Joint and Several Liability after the Economic Contract Guaranteed by Specialized Banks and Credit Cooperatives Is Confirmed Invalid

articles.content_en: 1. In accordance with the provisions of Article 89 of the General Principles of Civil Law of the People's Republic of China that "a guarantor shall guarantee to the creditor that the debtor shall perform the debt; if the debtor fails to perform the debt, the guarantor shall perform or bear joint and several liability as agreed" and Article 15 of the Economic Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, if a specialized bank or credit cooperative acts as a guarantor for a party to an economic contract, then when the guaranteed party fails to perform the contractual obligations, the guarantor shall perform or bear joint and several liability as agreed.

2. After an economic contract is confirmed invalid according to law, the property obtained by a party under such contract shall be returned to the other party. The party at fault shall compensate the other party for losses incurred thereby; if both parties are at fault, each shall bear the corresponding liability. Therefore, after a guaranteed economic contract is confirmed invalid, if the guaranteed party is required to return the property but fails to do so, or is required to compensate for losses but fails to do so, the guarantor shall bear joint and several liability, unless otherwise specially agreed.
This is our reply.
February 5, 1987
